description: This file defines the 'Window' object and class in Apache Spark's SQL module, providing utility functions for window functions in DataFrames, including partitioning, ordering, and frame boundary specifications.

classes.name: Window
classes.description: Utility object providing methods to create window specifications and define frame boundaries.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Creates a WindowSpec with specified partition columns, either by column names or Column objects.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Creates a WindowSpec with specified ordering columns, either by column names or Column objects.

methods.name: unboundedPreceding
methods.description: Represents the first row in the partition, equivalent to SQL's UNBOUNDED PRECEDING.

methods.name: unboundedFollowing
methods.description: Represents the last row in the partition, equivalent to SQL's UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING.

methods.name: currentRow
methods.description: Represents the current row in the window frame.

methods.name: rowsBetween
methods.description: Defines a frame from start to end positions relative to the current row.

methods.name: rangeBetween
methods.description: Defines a range-based frame from start to end values relative to the current row's value.
